commands.name: extract
commands.functionality: Get information from one or more agents by sending prompts and receiving answers
commands.example: Ask BackendAgent to design API / Узнай у BackendAgent про API

commands.name: create_agent
commands.functionality: Create a new specialized agent. type can be mock or llm. For llm use model_name from Models folder

usage_example.system_prompt: Ты security-агент. Отвечаешь за безопасность и уязвимости.

commands.name: edit_agent
commands.functionality: Edit existing agent metadata: type, model, role prompt, description and tags
commands.example: Edit SecurityAgent role / Измени роль SecurityAgent

commands.name: cancel
commands.functionality: Cancel current requested operation without changing agents or data

commands.name: list_agents
commands.functionality: Show all available agents and their metadata
commands.example: What agents are in the system? / Какие агенты есть?

commands.name: add
commands.functionality: Add new data or knowledge to an agent memory
commands.example: Save this report to BackendAgent / Добавь знание агенту

commands.name: delete
commands.functionality: Delete data or memory entry from an agent
commands.example: Remove outdated data from DevOpsAgent / Удали устаревшие данные

commands.name: edit
commands.functionality: Modify or update existing data inside an agent
commands.example: Update record in BackendAgent / Измени запись в агенте

commands.name: load
commands.functionality: Load a file into a selected agent for processing
commands.example: Load report.pdf into DevOpsAgent / Загрузи файл в агента

commands.name: route_document
commands.functionality: Intelligently route document to the best existing agent or create a new specialized agent and load document into it
commands.example: Load docs/api_report.txt into the most suitable agent / Загрузи документ в подходящего агента

commands.name: resolve_logger_conflicts
commands.functionality: Analyze registry metrics and resolve logger conflicts through central self-organization process
commands.example: Resolve agent conflicts / Разреши конфликты логгера

commands.name: consolidate
commands.functionality: Merge two or more agents into one new agent and remove originals
commands.example: Merge BackendAgent and DevOpsAgent into PlatformAgent

commands.name: split
commands.functionality: Split one agent into two specialized agents and remove original
commands.example: Split FullstackAgent into BackendAgent and FrontendAgent

commands.name: no_action
commands.functionality: Do nothing when no system change is required
